description: The Per Patient Day valuation calculator: from beds, occupancy and revenue and operating expense per patient day, returns patient days, EBITDARM, EBITDAR, rent coverage, NOI, value and value per bed at your cap rate, DSCR and loan to value on a loan you give, a HUD 232/223(f) loan estimate, and where your occupancy and revenue per day fall against the state's cost-report quartiles.

annual_rent.description: Annual rent in dollars if the operator leases the building; 0 if owned.

cap_rate_pct.description: Cap rate in percent: your assumption or your broker's (no public source sets it), e.g. 12.

expense_ppd.description: Operating expense per patient day in dollars, before rent, interest, depreciation and the management fee, e.g. 300.

interest_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent. Default 6 (the calculator's example input, not a quote).

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in dollars to test DSCR and loan to value; 0 to see only what the building supports.

mgmt_fee_pct.description: Management fee, percent of revenue. Default 5 (the calculator's example input).

reserve_per_bed.description: Replacement reserve, dollars per bed per year. Default 400 (the calculator's example input).

revenue_ppd.description: Net revenue per patient day in dollars, all payers, after contractual allowances, e.g. 350.

state.description: State to compare against: two-letter code or name, e.g. TX. Default "US".

name: snf_valuation
title: SNF valuation and debt coverage
